verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is one community comment confirming a Copilot integration exists inside Outlook, though the user found it slower than copy-pasting into another client. Nothing documents what tasks can be delegated to it. The Graph API, Inbox rules and mailbox-delegation docs are developer or rule-based features, not a built-in AI assistant. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the built-in assistant, evidence of which tasks can be delegated (drafting, triage, scheduling, summarizing), evidence of agentic task execution, and positive hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: They sometimes miss the Copilot integration, but say copy-pasting into Thunderbird is still faster than using Copilot in Outlook.
